requirements: An administrator can read one approved event without changing lifecycle state.
The event detail view joins readiness, placement, access, support, and capacity evidence.
The detail view contains no launch, reservation, activation, or reclaim controls.

observations.detail: GET /api/v1/events/{event_id} returned 404 because no single-event read contract existed.
The component suite could not resolve EventDetail because the event operations view did not exist.
